findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_sportsbook_surebets, get_world_cup_brief, get_world_cup_matchday · Private data: submit_forecast, check_bet, get_track_record, get_forecaster_record · Public sink: submit_forecast, get_world_cup_matchday, get_forecaster_record · Destructive: check_bet.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_sportsbook_surebets, get_world_cup_brief, get_world_cup_matchday · Private data: submit_forecast, check_bet, get_track_record, get_forecaster_record · Public sink: submit_forecast, get_world_cup_matchday, get_forecaster_record · Destructive: check_bet

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
